sources.title: [S16] Rank 1 Kassadin Complete Guide | By Coach xblademojo

passive.name: Void Stone
passive.text: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.

spells.name: Null Sphere
spells.text: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.

spells.name: Nether Blade
spells.text: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage and restores Mana.

spells.name: Force Pulse
spells.text: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.

spells.name: Riftwalk
spells.text: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.

damage.value: Kassadin primarily deals magic damage and can build for burst, while Muramana adds physical damage.

spikes.at: Rod of Ages and Archangel's Staff
spikes.why: Kassadin gains a consistent two-item core with durability, scaling, and damage.
Kassadin gains physical damage that diversifies his damage profile.
Kassadin gains an earlier offensive spike and higher burst but gives up durability.

bait.why: After Kassadin uses Nether Blade’s empowered attack, its cooldown keeps him from using another until it returns.
After Kassadin uses Force Pulse, its cooldown leaves him without that cone damage and slow.

mistakes.value: Kassadin players make a mistake when they memorise one build instead of adapting to the matchup and game state.
Kassadin spends more Mana on successive Riftwalks cast in a short period, so using them without accounting for the rising cost is a mistake.
